info.description:
This is Ora's api.

To use it you should create an application inside your organization. Check out our tutorial at https://help.ora.pm/article/79-getting-started-with-ora-public-api 

To try the API calls here, provide your application's client_id and client_secret in the authorization modal. Use https://api.ora.pm/swaggerui/oauth2-redirect.html as redirect uri
